description: This is a test class for the EmployeeOnLeaveDao component within the OrangeHRM Dashboard Plugin. It contains unit tests that verify fetching employee leave data based on various filters, as well as counting leave records. The class sets up test data fixtures and uses mock services to emulate dependencies.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmployeeOnLeaveDao, testing retrieval and counting of employee leave data with various filters.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and loads fixture data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeOnLeaveList
methods.description: Tests fetching a list of employee leave records with different date filters and access restrictions.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeOnLeaveCount
methods.description: Tests counting employee leave records with various filters.
